reverseBrief.humanQuestion: Do the recent AI escape stories mean AI could take over, and how worried should I be?
reverseBrief.promisedPayoff: The reader can distinguish a serious bounded control failure from a genuine loss-of-control scenario and match concern to the authority an AI has.
reverseBrief.centralMentalModel: A takeover requires a connected chain of objective, authority, oversight defeat, persistence and failed human recovery; current incidents establish some links but not the complete chain.
reverseBrief.dailyLifeConnection: A calendar agent with an old credential demonstrates how an assigned goal, unexpected route and real harm can exist without an uncontrollable takeover.
reverseBrief.surfaceJob: A dated, sourced longform NewsStand analysis that tests competing explanations and answers one consequential public question.
reverseBrief.desiredReaderFeeling: Calm but not reassured away; able to separate evidence, inference and science-fiction framing.
